method: Whole-view comparison of each panorama (1148x1063, pitched up) with its dry render at the same size from the same camera at 90 degree vertical field of view; positions read on each feature's own row.
note: Number 20 is read from the pass 70 panorama facing it (camera 2.3 m, base row at 0 on the district outline); its joints lie at y 37.53 and 49.53. Two panoramas on Norra Långgatan were resected: the western one on the corner house's west corner and its base row (its height is ambiguous along the corner ray, and 2.3 m puts it on its reported position), the eastern one on the range's east end and the corner, which then predicts the joint between range and corner house within 3 px and puts its base row at 0. The range's floor heights read from the two cameras differ by about 0.35 m (the street slopes); their mean is used. Roofs are estimates: number 20's mansard, the corner house's hipped roof and a low dark roof behind the range's dormers.
